cover: Walk through a flagged payment with compliance

slides.title: Does every payment route hit the check?
slides.body: Including routes added later. On one platform it sits in the function that identifies the donor, before any payment exists.

slides.title: What if the lists can’t be reached?
slides.body: Declining is the safe default. If you’d rather let payments through, record who decided that and why.

slides.title: What does the donor see?
slides.body: A neutral decline that never mentions a watchlist. Most flags are possible matches, and a person judges how strong the match is.

slides.title: Who reviews it, and what’s kept?
slides.body: Name the person who reviews a possible match, and decide what evidence you keep about the case.

slides.title: Are the passes on record?
slides.body: A log of blocks alone can’t show you screened everyone. Keep the clears on record too.

slides.title: Has matching been tested on real names?
slides.body: A naive check flagged six of twenty ordinary donor names. One extra word of slack brought it to three. Write down the gaps.
